create: I've added that to your calendar.
general: Here's what I found on your calendar.

next_event.description: The event scheduled, or the event set last that a query found; "No upcoming events" when a query finds none

event_time.description: The time of the event scheduled, found or cancelled, as given; "" when none was given or a query finds none

event_date.description: The date of the event scheduled, found or cancelled, as given; "" when none was given or a query finds none; null for an event stored without one

cancelled_count.description: How many events a cancel removed: always 1, since a cancel removes exactly one
